title: Adjacent Onix Ram is too slow to hurt the player

verification.actor: One current WILD Onix (species 95) at Route 29 tile (585,408), adjacent to the player at (585,407).
verification.trigger: Wait for Onix to gain its normal Ram application, then leave both actors in place for 80 completed game frames with no player input.
verification.observable: The live and saved player HP stay at 100, accepted hit count stays zero, and field control does not enter battle.

setupMutations.change: Use checked teleport, native Wild Onix spawn, and exact live identity bind. Keep Onix movement, Ram policy, damage, and player HP unmodified.

limits: Prepared adjacent placement tests the Ram speed boundary, not natural population spawn selection.
The actor application and 80 field frames are observed; this does not directly record a rejected collision callback.
A missing current adjacent Onix, lost Ram application, player movement, damage, accepted hit, battle, or wrong save HP fails.

events.value: Place and bind current Wild Onix adjacent to the player.
Observe active Ram application and 80 neutral field frames.
Read live and saved player HP after the low-speed window.

stop.condition: Ram application, 80 adjacent neutral frames, and final checked HP receipt, or first failed identity, field, application, or HP check.

invariants: Current WILD Onix remains adjacent during the Ram window
